draft.summary: Fix the pickup time shown in confirmation emails
draft.description:
## Context
Type: Bug (created as Task; this Jira project has no Bug type).

Phase: 1.

Found by QA (Sofía Rojas). Andrés Gil suspects a time zone problem in the email template; not verified.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Place an order and choose a pickup time of 10:00.
2. Open the confirmation email.

## Expected Behavior
The email shows the pickup time the customer chose (10:00).

## Current Behavior
The email shows 08:00, two hours earlier.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: **Pickup time in the email** (Happy path) — A customer chooses a pickup time of 10:00 and receives the confirmation email. Expected: the email shows 10:00.

## References, Risks and Dependencies
Open question: is it only the email template or also other places that show the pickup time? Not discussed.

## Completion Checklist
- [ ] Fix completed.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met.
- [ ] Fix verified in the environment where it failed.
- [ ] Review and approval recorded.
- [ ] Documentation updated, if applicable.

## Completion Evidence
Pending — to be linked as it becomes available.
